desc:
Amazon SEO and PPC one-to-one coaching teaches you or your team to run listings and ads in house. Ecom Swift LLC leads private video calls using your real account, so every lesson is about your own products and your own campaigns.

## What is Amazon SEO and PPC coaching?

Coaching is live teaching on video calls, built around your account instead of a general course. Amazon SEO is the skill of writing and structuring listings so shoppers and the search system understand them. PPC is the skill of running paid ads, including keywords, bids and budgets. Together they decide how often your products are seen and how much each visit costs.

Rather than doing the work for you, we show you how it is done, why each choice matters and how to check your own results.

## Why learn the skills yourself

Many sellers pay for work they could handle with a few hours of guidance. Others copy advice from videos and forums that does not suit their category or fit Amazon's rules. Both paths cost money, either in fees or in mistakes.

Knowing the basics gives you control. You can write a new listing the day a product arrives, read a search term report without waiting for someone else, and tell whether an outside provider is doing good work. A team that shares the same method also keeps its pages and campaigns consistent.

## How coaching affects your results

Coaching works by changing habits. When you understand why a title leads with the main phrase, or why a bid must sit below your margin, each later decision improves. Over time the account is maintained more carefully and with fewer costly guesses.

Because lessons use your products, the improvements start during the call. We do not promise higher sales, since price, reviews and competition also play a part. We teach methods that work within Amazon's rules and help you judge your own data.

## What a good coaching program includes

- A first call to set your goals and review your current listings.
- Keyword research taught on your own products.
- Listing writing for titles, bullets and backend terms.
- How to read search term reports and spot waste.
- Setting bids and budgets from your margins.
- Policy risks, such as claims, prohibited words and brand names.
- Homework between calls, with feedback.
- Call notes and a short checklist for each topic.
- Recordings you can share with your team.

## How the sessions work

You choose the topic for the first call, or we suggest one after a short chat about your account. Each call lasts about an hour, over video. We look at a real listing or campaign together and you make the changes while we watch, so the learning sticks.

After each call you receive notes and a checklist. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages offer one, two or three calls, with homework review, call recordings, listing reviews, a campaign review and a written team playbook as the package grows. The sessions are private, and we only look inside your accounts if you choose to share them.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Bring real listings and campaigns to every call.
- Decide on one or two goals before the first session.
- Do the homework so the next call builds on it.
- Share the recording and checklist with anyone who helps you.
- Write down questions as they come up.

**Avoid:**
- Trying to learn every topic in one call.
- Copying a competitor's text word for word.
- Changing many things on a live listing without notes.
- Skipping the policy topics because they seem dull.
- Sharing your password with anyone, including a coach.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner who wants to manage listings and ads without paying an agency each month. It also suits a team member who has just been given the Amazon account and needs a structured start. A seller who already works with a provider can use coaching to check the work and ask better questions.

## What we need from you

Please tell us your level, your category and what you most want to learn. If you want account-based lessons, you can share your screen on the call or invite us as a user with limited permissions. We never need your password.
